player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Decktech''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
description: The Anti-WYS Scum deck is now ready. It is also Anti-Bespin Celebration. The 2 deck that are good... all the other LS deck will always suck anyways...
cards: posted: Dr E. and Ponda Baba
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Sh1t': Tatooine: Desert Heart, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace ('TatJab paloce'), Prepared Defenses ('Prepared Defence'), Power Of The Hutt ('POWER OF TA MÈRE'), There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement ('Opressive/Sh1t or Sh1t not') and No Bargain ('No bargain B1tch'); they count toward the 60. No Objective; Desert Heart (listed first) is set as the starting location. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
'Starting Sh1t', 'Blue' (starships/vehicles), 'Red' (Effects) and 'Temporary red' (Interrupts) are section headers, not cards; without them the list adds to 60.

Posted 'POWER OF TA MÈRE' ('ta mère' is French for 'your mother') dested Power Of The Hutt, the Prepared Defenses Effect of a Jabba's Palace start; 'Opressive/Sh1t or Sh1t not' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (the same author's 'Opressive Enforcement / There is no Try' in DeckTech 15187).

Posted 'Endor Operation' (listed among the Interrupts) dested Endor Occupation, the Dark Endor Interrupt that cancels Cloud City Celebration: the strategy says 'Endor Ops witch cancel celebration' and the deck is built against Bespin Celebration; the Endor Operations Objective cannot be in a deck that starts Desert Heart.
Posted 'Scum and nipples x2' dested Scum And Villainy (a unique Effect), kept x2 as published; 'Guri Boat' dested Stinger (Guri's starship).

'YISYW' is printed as written: that abbreviation is the Light Effect Your Insight Serves You Well, which cannot be in a Dark deck. The strategy mentions switching 'YCHForever' (You Cannot Hide Forever) for Resistance, so it is probably You Cannot Hide Forever, but the posted name does not say that.

Posted 'Iggy w/ gun', '4 lom w/ gun', 'Fett w/ gun', 'Dengar w/ gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Zuckuss in ship' / 'Bossk in ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter / Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Sail Barge' Jabba's Sail Barge; 'Sail Barg Passenger Deck' Jabba's Sail Barge: Passenger Deck; 'Audience Chamber' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark).

Posted 'Bib' dested Bib Fortuna; 'Merc. Pilot' Mercenary Pilot; 'Dr E. and Ponda Baba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (the only Dark Mara Jade character then); 'Twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Barrier' Imperial Barrier; 'Monok' Monnok; 'Massa move' Masterful Move; 'Jabba's Throught with you' Jabba's Through With You; 'Hell to pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Ghhhk' the plain Ghhhk (not the combo).
The strategy also mentions No Escape and Resistance as optional swaps; they are not in the list.
